annotations.title: Read an EU or ECHR decision in full

description: Fetch the FULL text of one CJEU or ECHR decision. Use it after search_eu_jurisprudence finds a ruling you want to quote — the search returns only the matching passage, this returns the judgment. Accepts whatever identifier you are holding: a CJEU case number (C-131/12, T-604/18 — the judgment, or the Advocate General's opinion if you say "concluzii"/"opinion"), a CELEX (62013CJ0438), an ECLI (ECLI:EU:C:2014:317), a HUDOC itemid (001-251188), an ECHR application number (74061/17), or the case name. Judgments are long, so pass `section` to get only the part you need: "dispozitiv" for the operative ruling, "fapte" for the facts, "drept" for the legal reasoning, or any keyword.

case.description: CJEU case number (C-131/12), CELEX, ECLI, HUDOC itemid, ECHR application number, or case name.

court.description: Which corpus to search. Default: both.

name: lookup_eu_decision
